_note: STATEFUL. One record per day: which top-8 list was on show and the eight moments it carried, appended by build_cards.record_top8_day() and never rewritten. Do not regenerate this file and do not delete it to clean up - the sequence of what was on show is the thing it holds, and a rebuild from scratch cannot reconstruct a day nobody was there for. Rendered as the day record on /top8/ by build_cards.t8_record().
